# SaltWatch Card 0.5.8

This patch softens the shading at the bottom of the salt tank for a more natural, evenly lit appearance.

## What changed

- Reduced the brown depth gradient over the salt tablets.
- Softened the window vignette, especially near the bottom edge and corners.
- Retained subtle depth so the tablet image still looks integrated into the tank.

## Compatibility

- Existing card configurations continue to work without changes.
- No dashboard YAML changes are required.
- The emulator and SaltWatch firmware are unaffected.

## Validation

- 49 unit tests passed.
- 45 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile profiles; one desktop-only mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
